factories.name: new_send_event_step
factories.description: POST one JSON event to the connection's HTTPS delivery URL, signed with the Standard Webhooks scheme. Delivery is at least once: after a 408, 409, 425, 429, or 5xx answer, a timeout, or a lost response the same webhook-id is sent again with a fresh timestamp and signature, so the receiver must deduplicate by webhook-id and answer 2xx for an id it already applied.

inputSchema.description: SendEventInput is one JSON event that sendEvent POSTs to the connection's deliveryUrl.

payload.description: Payload is the complete JSON request body, such as {"type":"form.submitted","data":{...}}. It must be one valid JSON value of at most maxBodyBytes bytes; an empty or invalid payload selects defect.
